scope: 150 discovery episodes: IDs0..49 in each collection seed1,2,3; validation and confirmation tensors never opened

method.cross_validation: Held collection seed, with metric fit on training seeds only
method.multioutput_r2: 1 - summed squared world/target error divided by summed per-coordinate centered target variation
method.inference: Discovery descriptive analysis; no multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims

label_definitions.step_progress: goal_distance[t] - goal_distance[t+1], across five raw actions, positive toward goal
label_definitions.cumulative_progress: goal_distance[0] - goal_distance[t], before the corresponding transition
label_definitions.action_direction: sum of five raw XYZ translations divided by its L2 norm; zero-net rows stored as zero and masked from readouts
label_definitions.action_net_norm: L2 norm of the sum of five raw XYZ translations
label_definitions.action_chunk_frobenius_magnitude: sqrt(sum over five actions and XYZ coordinates of action squared); differs from net norm under cancellation
label_definitions.wall_clearance: Cached signed distance from end effector to the wall box

regime_dependence.time_confounding: Regimes have different time and trajectory composition; residual differences do not identify causal regimes or HMM states.
